title: BIOTRAM: Biochemistry-informed Transformer for Relative Abundance via Metabarcoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.05418v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Arthropod monitoring at scale begins with metabarcoding of bulk samples: trap collections of hundreds to thousands of specimens processed as one unit, extraction of DNA from the bulked specimens, then sequencing of the DNA from all specimens together. Metabarcoding reveals which taxa such a sample contains, but due to factors such as differing DNA amplification rates and body sizes, its read counts do not neatly correspond to how abundant the different taxa are relative to one another. This lack of relative abundance limits the data's utility for the multitude of ecological analyses that depend on it. We propose BIOTRAM: a neural network that estimates per-taxon specimen counts by dividing the observed read counts by a learned read yield per specimen, which it factors into the DNA each specimen contributes and how efficiently that DNA is amplified. translated_title: BIOTRAM：基于生物化学信息的Transformer模型，用于通过元条形码技术估计相对丰度
translated_abstract: 节肢动物的大规模监测始于对批量样本的元条形码处理：陷阱采集的数百至数千个标本作为一个整体单元处理，从批量标本中提取DNA，然后对所有标本的DNA进行混合测序。元条形码能够揭示样本中包含哪些分类群，但由于DNA扩增速率和体型大小等因素的差异，其读段计数并不能准确对应不同分类群之间的相对丰度。这种相对丰度信息的缺失限制了此类数据在众多依赖该信息的生态分析中的实用性。我们提出了BIOTRAM：一种神经网络，它通过将观测到的读段计数除以学习得到的每个标本的读段产出量来估计各分类群的标本数量，该读段产出量被分解为每个标本所贡献的DNA量以及该DNA的扩增效率。在一个包含1,188个瓶子（80万个标本）的配对数据集上，这些样本同时通过元条形码处理（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: BIOTRAM是一种融合生物化学知识的Transformer神经网络，通过学习每个标本的DNA贡献量和扩增效率来校正元条形码读段计数偏差，从而实现从批量样本中准确估计节肢动物各分类群的相对丰度。
en_tdlr: BIOTRAM is a biochemistry-informed Transformer that corrects metabarcoding read-count bias by learning per-specimen DNA yield and amplification efficiency, enabling accurate estimation of relative abundance of arthropod taxa from bulk samples.
